concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-verification-requirements]] — 2023-modified guide captured 2026-09-15 for platform user-verification inputs by country, legal-entity type and financial product, with minor-user, business-account, issuing and Capital qualifications; requirements do not prove verification or capability approval.
warnings: Apply this reciprocal route after the C15 platforms foundation concept is created; this worker does not propose a duplicate concept.
Age, legal-entity, country and US business-account rules are a historical page snapshot, not current legal/compliance guidance or proof of eligibility.
Required data and a capability-level table do not establish actual verification status, enabled capability, payment processing, payout or bank receipt.
